ADM-002.Summary: Use of net localgroup to add AD group to local administrators
ADM-002.Troubleshooting History: Describes the process of using the command 'net localgroup administrators "CORP\YourAdminGroupName" /add' to add an Active Directory group to local administrators. This is often used for granting administrative rights through group policies.
